judge: claude-opus-5-5, from contact sheets of the source videos and 1 fps frames of each window (run/bench-20261018/frames, git-ignored). All missed incidents were verified to be inside the window Hafnia received.

test_01.note: Caught: 'colliding with a parked auto-rickshaw ... rider is thrown from the bike'. Rider 'walks away' is not shown.

test_02.note: Caught: 'A train ... colliding with a motorcycle ... rider to be thrown to the ground'. Calls it 'minor injuries'.

test_03.note: Missed: describes vehicles stopping and passing; no contact between the motorbike and the bicycle. Hard clip.

test_04.note: Missed and contradicted: 'Traffic flows smoothly with no collisions', while a cyclist is knocked down.

test_05.note: Missed and contradicted: 'The rider yields ... no collisions', while the scooter crashes into the truck.

test_06.note: Accurate about what is visible (hooded person with a bag crossing a lot at night), but flags nothing suspicious; no fire is visible.

test_07.note: Missed: 'enters ... carrying a white tray ... no signs of distress or conflict', while masked men rush in.

test_08.note: Missed: 'steps back outside and closes the door'; the masked intruder enters. No mention of the mask.

test_09.note: Partly: sees the fall, but explains it as 'slips on the slick pavement'; the scene shows a man collapsing near a car (shooting).

test_10.note: Missed: 'pedestrian exits the vehicle'; no person on the ground, no one aiming.
